introHtml: No-minimum custom badge ID holders let you order exactly what you need—whether that's 10, 25, or 50 units—without being forced into bulk quantities. Small businesses, startups, and HR directors managing small teams can now get fully customized badge holders with logos, colors, and imprint options that match your brand. Skip the inventory overload and per-unit pricing that works for lower volumes makes this a smart fit for one-off events, pilot programs, or team expansions.
